admission.justification: Proved across all 41 live DAG nodes and XML-escaping fixtures in tests/unit/test_site_compiler.py and Playwright getBBox checks; prevents clipped overflowing file paths and colliding global SVG marker/clipPath IDs on rendered stage pages.

applicability: Inline SVG stage dependency mini-map rendering in src/rh_pipeline/site/renderers.py across all 8 pillars and 41 extracted DAG nodes.
conditions: _render_minimap_node enforces MINIMAP_PATH_CHAR_BUDGET (46 chars) and _MINIMAP_TITLE_CHAR_BUDGET (40 chars) via _middle_ellipsis inside 340px node boxes while preserving the untruncated upstream_path inside each node <g>'s <title> tooltip and the ordered Markdown dependency list beneath.

_render_minimap_defs emits stage-scoped arrow marker IDs (rh-minimap-arrow-{stage_id}) and per-node clipPath IDs (rh-minimap-clip-{stage_id}-{idx}) so multiple minimaps on one page never collide on global SVG IDs.
exclusions: Hand-authored stage concept diagrams under <memory>/docs/assets/*.svg are outside minimap SVG generation.

evidence: tests/unit/test_site_compiler.py & Playwright getBBox() check across all 8 stages / 41 nodes (0 overflows) in round-1-evidence.tar.gz::playwright-out/playwright-results.json

statement: Stage dependency mini-map SVGs enforce a deterministic label character budget with middle-ellipsis path truncation, full upstream_path <title> tooltips, and unique per-stage/per-node clipPath and marker IDs so all 41 nodes fit cleanly inside their boxes.
title: Deterministic stage minimap SVG width budget, tooltips and unique SVG IDs
